name: DEP-01: Direct counter pool smaller than tentries [SEM S8]
setup: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
$TC p4template create extern/root/DirectCounter extid 0x1A000000 numinstances 2 has_exec_method

$TC p4template create extern_inst/ptables/DirectCounter/cnt instid 1 tc_numel 2 tbl_bindable constructor param type ptype bit32 0 control_path tc_key index ptype bit32 id 1 param pkts ptype bit64 id 2
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname2 tblid 2 keysz 32 table_acts act name NoAction tentries 16 pna_direct_counter DirectCounter/cnt
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname2 entry srcPort 1 dstPort 1
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname2 entry srcPort 2 dstPort 1
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname2 entry srcPort 3 dstPort 1
verifyCmd: { $TC p4template update pipeline/ptables state ready; $TC p4ctrl create ptables/table/cb/tname2 srcPort 9 dstPort 1; echo rc=$?; $TC -j p4ctrl get ptables/table/cb/tname2; } 2>&1; true
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'

setup: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname2 tblid 2 keysz 32 table_acts act name NoAction
for i in $(seq 1 20); do $TC p4ctrl create ptables/table/cb/tname2 srcPort $i dstPort 1 || exit 1; done
cmdUnderTest: $TC p4ctrl del ptables/table/cb/tname2 && (for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc")
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'

name: DEP-09a: Removing hit and miss bindings preserves the pipeline-owned action
setup: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
$TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32
$TC actions add action ptables/test param param1 1 index 17
$TC p4template create table/ptables/cb/tname keysz 16 table_acts act name ptables/test default_hit_action action ptables/test index 17
$TC p4template update table/ptables/cb/tname default_miss_action action ptables/test index 17
cmdUnderTest: $TC actions del action ptables/test index 17 2>/tmp/p4tc-spec-$TESTID.err; echo rc=$? > /tmp/p4tc-spec-$TESTID.out
verifyCmd: (set -eu; err=/tmp/p4tc-spec-$TESTID.err; snapshot=/tmp/p4tc-spec-$TESTID.json; expect_error() { pattern=$1; shift; if "$@" >"$err" 2>&1; then cat "$err"; exit 1; else rc=$?; fi; cat "$err"; [ "$rc" -eq 255 ]; grep -Fq "$pattern" "$err"; }; check_action() { $TC -j actions get action ptables/test index 17 >"$snapshot"; python3 -c 'import json,sys; a=[a for r in json.load(sys.stdin) for a in r.get("actions",[]) if a.get("kind")=="ptables/test" and a.get("index")==17]; assert len(a)==1; assert (a[0]["ref"],a[0]["bind"])==tuple(map(int,sys.argv[1:]))' "$1" "$2" <"$snapshot"; echo "ACTION_REFS=$1/$2"; cat "$snapshot"; }; grep -Fxq rc=255 /tmp/p4tc-spec-$TESTID.out; grep -Fq 'Unable to delete preallocated action' "$err"; check_action 3 2; $TC p4template del table/ptables/cb/tname; check_action 1 0; expect_error 'Unable to delete preallocated action' $TC actions del action ptables/test index 17; expect_error 'Unable to delete referenced action template' $TC p4template del action/ptables/test; $TC p4template del pipeline/ptables; expect_error 'Pipeline name not found' $TC p4template get pipeline/ptables; $TC p4template create pipeline/ptables pipeid 22 numtables 4; $TC p4template create action/ptables/test actid 1 param param1 type bit32; $TC p4template update action/ptables/test state active; $TC actions add action ptables/test param param1 2 index 17; check_action 1 0; $TC p4template del pipeline/ptables; expect_error 'Pipeline name not found' $TC p4template get pipeline/ptables; echo PIPELINE_OWNERSHIP_OK) 2>&1
teardown: sh -c 'for attempt in $(seq 1 200); do output=$($TC p4template del pipeline/ptables 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && break; case "$output" in *"Pipeline in use"*) sleep 0.05;; *) break;; esac; done; [ -z "$output" ] || printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$output" >&2; exit "$rc"'
